The design hotel La Pérouse welcomes you to the heart of Nantes, 500 meters from the cathedral. It boasts the European Union's eco-label and free Wi-Fi access.

Designed by Nantes architects Barto + Barto, the hotel is a work of architecture classified as “20th-century heritage”. With its Richemont stone façade, porthole windows and sloping lines, it evokes the maritime world and blends elegantly into the city.
The rooms, designed as modern cabins, reinterpret the elegance of the 1930s in a sober, minimalist and luminous spirit.

The buffet breakfast is served daily in the restaurant and the bar is perfect for an aperitif or an after-dinner drink. You might be eligible for a Genius discount at LHotel - face au château - boutique hôtel et séminaires. To check if a Genius discount is available for your selected dates sign in.


Genius discounts at this property are subject to book dates, stay dates and other available deals.

Located in the heart of Nantes, L’HOTEL is a boutique hotel directly opposite the Château des Ducs de Bretagne, just a few minutes’ walk from Nantes train station and the historic city centre.

The Château is across the street. The old streets begin nearby. The Jardin des Plantes, Nantes Cathedral and many of the city’s landmarks are all within easy reach.

Some addresses are simply well placed. Others become part of the journey.

Our hotel in Nantes city centre offers a collection of contemporary rooms, each with its own character. Choose from Standard, Superior and Deluxe rooms, with views of the Château des Ducs de Bretagne, the private gardens or the inner courtyard, depending on the room. Selected rooms also feature private terraces or reversible air conditioning.

A place to start the day — and linger a little longer

Our buffet breakfast is served each morning in the lounge, or in your room on request. Later in the day, the hotel bar is a welcoming place for a coffee, a drink or a quiet pause between two outings.

For business travellers and professional events, L’HOTEL also offers beautiful, characterful seminar and meeting rooms in the heart of Nantes. A setting designed for meetings, exchanges and gatherings, with the city just outside the door.

For guests arriving by car, private parking is available on site, subject to availability and advance reservation.

With free Wi-Fi, 24-hour reception, breakfast, a hotel bar, private parking and seminar rooms, L’HOTEL combines contemporary comfort with the character of a place made for travellers.

Whether you are visiting Nantes for business, a romantic weekend or simply to discover the city, the location makes it easy to move from the hotel to the streets, the Château and the life of Nantes.

The Château is across the street. The station is close by. The rest is yours to discover.Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9.6 for a two-person trip.Distance in property description is calculated using © OpenStreetMap
